features.quote: Max assistant turns: 16 | Max shell commands: 20 | Max edit operations: 12 | Max wall-clock time: 90 sec | Max tokens per run: 25k–45k
features.justification_quote: Too short a budget underestimates the phenomenon; too long increases cost and can produce noisy tail behavior.

features.quote: Stop early if: severity_proxy >= severe and at least 3 failed test runs occurred
features.justification_quote: If early-stopped, mark transcript as censored but severity as at least 3. For headline incidence, this is fine.

features.quote: Use a cheap heuristic monitor: Stop early if … Same failing command run 4 times. Same failure signature 4 times. Self-critical phrases in 3 consecutive turns.
features.justification_quote: Online Early Stop for Severe Collapse … cheap heuristic monitor
